name: 06 — Agent escalates with needs_assistance terminal status
description: Agent decides on iteration 2 that it cannot proceed without human guidance and emits status='needs_assistance' with a user_message asking for clarification. The orchestrator must stop the loop after that iteration (the while-condition only continues while status==='running'), emit a session_complete with the needs_assistance status, and persist the session with that terminal status. No iteration_limit event is expected because the cap was not reached.
